selection: PipeWire and SPA public C headers only; SPA inline functions compile into the module. No shared PipeWire library or daemon is required to build/load the module.
local_changes: Vendored ABI headers replace system-deps probing; SPA inline glue is linked statically. The private PipeWire client binding exposes and requires its referenced C symbol surface through runtime-optional loading. Initialization/library handles are released after module workers drain. Raw C varargs are called through checked function pointers. No portal FD or consent changes.

header_backports.effect: Enum discriminant only; no host codec support or newer C layout/function required.
